scope: Cross-candidate discriminator for PR #741 ClayVM Bytes/v2 and PR #744 String path process hostcall; sandbox-only evidence, not product acceptance.

observed_reality: PR #741 extends ClayValue with immutable bytes snapshots.
PR #744 defines linux.process.spawn.path.v1::(String)->Int and fails closed when its path hostcall receives a non-string value.
grf.generated_hypothesis: The two candidates can be fused while preserving a nominal String-vs-Bytes authority boundary.
grf.counter_reality: A future fusion may implicitly UTF-8 decode Bytes and accidentally grant path/process authority to opaque byte values.
grf.falsifier: Pass a byte-exact valid-UTF8 pathname doppelganger through the String path dispatch shape and require fail-closed rejection.
grf.outcome: RETAIN the nominal separation as a fusion invariant; whole-machine acceptance remains false.

exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.name: UTF8_BYTES_DOPPELGANGER_PATH_MUST_NOT_GAIN_STRING_PROCESS_AUTHORITY
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.intervention: Pass the byte-exact valid-UTF8 path-shaped Bytes value into the PR #744 String path hostcall dispatch shape.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: No product mutation; experiment-only local probe.

architecture_delta.fusion_requirement: Retain nominal String-vs-Bytes separation at process/effect hostcall signatures. Do not auto-decode Clay Bytes to String merely because the byte payload is valid UTF-8 or pathname-shaped.
architecture_delta.merged_regression_requirement: When #741/#744 semantics are composed, assert the exact valid-UTF8 Bytes pathname doppelganger case as an ordinary regression; do not count it as a new unusual experiment again.
non_claims: No product repository code was changed by this experiment.
No current-head EntityOS artifact was built or verified by this experiment.
No Clay Machine acceptance is claimed.
